description:
Cast Myr Battlesphere by paying {7}.
Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Genesis Chamber.
Resolve the Myr Battlesphere trigger, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Resolve the Genesis Chamber trigger, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks five times by sacrificing the Myr tokens, adding ten {C}.
Activate Mirage Mirror by paying {2}, targeting Myr Battlesphere.
Cowardice triggers, returning Myr Battlepshere from the battlefield to your hand.
Mirage Mirror's ability fails to resolve  due to no longer having a legal target.
Repeat.
